dedupe_keys.name: mnt grid nord pas de calais 2012 2013

description: MNT GRID Nord-Pas de Calais 2012-2013 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ppige-npdc.fr. Digital terrain model (DTM) produced from stereoscopic aerial photographs at 20 cm spatial resolution of PPIGE 2012-2013 orthophotography. It is presented in the form of a seedling of points with steps of 10 and 20 meters covering the whole of the Northern Region - Pas de Calais. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include mnt, ppige, altitude, 2012, modèle numérique de terrain, 2013. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ECW. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
